import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'

const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()

const out = '/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots'
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true })
const browser = await chromium.launch(config.browser.launchOptions)
const errors = []

async function shot(name, width, height, mobile = false, steps = null) {
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height }, isMobile: mobile, hasTouch: mobile })
  page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(name + ': ' + e.message))
  page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(name + ' console: ' + m.text()) })
  await page.goto('http://localhost:4173/', { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 60000 })
  await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
  await page.click('#playBtn', { timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {})
  await page.waitForTimeout(2200)
  if (steps) await steps(page)
  await page.waitForTimeout(800)
  await page.screenshot({ path: join(out, name), type: 'jpeg', quality: 78 })
  const state = await page.evaluate(() => ({ loading: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#loading')).display, quest: document.querySelector('#quest')?.textContent, shards: document.querySelector('#shards')?.textContent }))
  await page.close()
  return state
}

  await page.waitForTimeout(900)
  await page.keyboard.press('Space')

  await page.mouse.down()

  await page.mouse.up()
  await page.waitForTimeout(900)
})

await browser.close()
